title: acelus.lock
description: Fully resolved, reproducible description of a Minecraft instance. Every artifact is pinned by content hash, byte size and origin URL so the instance can be rebuilt bit-for-bit on any machine.

lockVersion.description: Schema version of this lockfile. Incremented on breaking changes to the format.

generatedBy.description: Version of Acelus that produced this lockfile.

minecraft.description: The resolved Minecraft version this instance runs.

type.description: Release channel reported by Mojang's version manifest.

manifestSha1.description: SHA-1 of the version JSON as published by Mojang, used to detect upstream mutation.

assetIndexId.description: Identifier of the asset index this version uses.

complianceLevel.description: Mojang compliance level; 0 means the version predates modern launcher safety features.

loader.description: Mod loader layered on top of the vanilla version. Absent for a vanilla instance.

intermediaryVersion.description: Intermediary mappings version, for Fabric and Quilt.

java.description: The Java runtime this instance must be launched with.

component.description: Mojang runtime component name, for example java-runtime-delta.

source.description: Where the runtime is provisioned from. Mojang does not publish runtimes for every target, so Adoptium is the documented fallback.

artifacts.description: Every file the instance needs, keyed by its path relative to the instance root.

path.description: Destination path relative to the instance root.

role.description: What this artifact is, which determines how it is materialized and whether it joins the classpath.

size.description: Exact byte length. A mismatch fails verification before the hash is even checked.

blake3.description: Content-addressed store key. BLAKE3 is used internally because it is substantially faster than SHA-1 while remaining collision resistant.

sha1.description: Vendor-supplied SHA-1, present for artifacts Mojang publishes. Verified in addition to blake3 so upstream substitution is detected.

sha512.description: Vendor-supplied SHA-512, present for artifacts sourced from Modrinth.

origin.description: URLs this artifact may be fetched from, in preference order. Hosts are checked against the allowlist before any request is made.

extract.description: Extraction directives for native archives that must be unpacked rather than placed verbatim.
